name: Fuel Prices
description: Gas station locations and real-time fuel prices

tankerkoenig.purpose: German fuel station prices (E5, E10, Diesel)
tankerkoenig.dataSent: Center coordinates (latitude, longitude), search radius (max 25 km)
tankerkoenig.dataReceived: Gas stations with name, brand, address, coordinates, live diesel/E5/E10 prices, open/closed status

e-control-at.dataSent: Center coordinates (latitude, longitude), search radius, fuel type (diesel and Super 95 queried separately)
e-control-at.dataReceived: Gas stations with name, address, coordinates, prices per fuel type, open/closed status

prix-carburants-fr.purpose: French fuel station prices (6 fuel types)
prix-carburants-fr.dataReceived: Gas stations with address, coordinates, prices for 6 fuel types with update timestamps

minetur-es.purpose: Spanish fuel station prices (5 fuel types)
minetur-es.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire national dataset)
minetur-es.dataReceived: All Spanish gas stations with name, address, coordinates, prices for 5 fuel types

osm.purpose: Fuel station locations (global fallback, no prices)
osm.dataReceived: OSM fuel station nodes with name, operator, address
